about_blocks.text: Programs and services at Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre
about_blocks.html: Programs and services at Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre

about_blocks.text: At Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre, we offer comprehensive assessments, 3-month live-in treatment, 3-month post-live-in continuing care, and family services including education, counselling, and support. Our programs are tailored to meet the specific needs of each youth who comes to us for assistance. We use evidence-based methods to help our clients overcome substance use and related problems and to achieve a healthier lifestyle. Our 3-month live-in treatment program is the only Centre of its kind in Eastern Ontario.

about_blocks.text: A professional referral is not necessary to gain access to our services at Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre. Also, no formal fees are required to participate in our programming. We value the support of our community and receive support from The Ontario Ministry of Health and Long Term Care (MoHLTC), and Champlain Local Health Integration Network (LHIN).

about_blocks.text: Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre’s history and founder
about_blocks.html: Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre’s history and founder

about_blocks.text: The Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre (Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre) was established in 1993. We were founded as a result of the relentless efforts of a group of people, led by Ottawa restaurateur and philanthropist, Dave Smith. Since 1993, Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre has helped hundreds of youth and families each year as a Day Treatment program. In 2010, we were chosen to alter our mandate to deliver live-in and aftercare treatment services for youth and families across the province.

about_blocks.text: For over 25 years, Dave Smith Youth Treatment Centre has been dedicated to helping youth and families overcome substance use and related issues.
